tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Ivory page background behind every screen. Text: `text`, `text-muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid cards, list rows, form fields and long reading sections. Never make these transparent.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Soft cream: chip counts, read-only fields, skeleton base, quiet panels.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Blush: selected nav pill, secondary buttons, avatar tint, progress track. `primary` text reads on it.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`, `blush` and both glass fills (≥ 12:1 light, ≥ 13:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, help text, metadata on `bg` and `surface` (≥ 7:1 light, ≥ 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card edges and dividers. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders (≥ 3:1 on `surface` and `bg`).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Burgundy: the one main action per screen, links, selected states, focus of attention. White text on it (8.9:1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover burgundy.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Champagne gold: monogram ring, decorative hairlines, progress highlights. Not for text on light grounds (2:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Champagne tint behind Important/Due-today badges; text on it is `warning`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, Coming, Paid text and icons on `success-soft`, `surface`.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and toasts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting, Due, waiting-to-send text on `warning-soft`, `accent-soft`, `surface`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for waiting/due badges, offline queue rows.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue, errors, destructive actions on `danger-soft` and `surface` (6:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error banners, field errors, overdue badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Doing, Family role, neutral notices on `info-soft`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for info badges and banners.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring on every interactive element (≥ 3:1 on all grounds).

tokens.name: glass-white
tokens.usage: Frosted white: countdown tiles over the hero, bottom nav, floating controls, small stat cards. Always with 18px blur and `glass-border`; text is `text`.

tokens.name: glass-blush
tokens.usage: Frosted blush: selected filter chips and highlight panels; text is `primary`.

tokens.name: glass-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs: nearly opaque so long text stays readable.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: The fine light edge on every glass surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims content behind sheets/dialogs, and the bottom of photos under white headlines.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Home hero headline over the couple photo (white on `scrim`). One per screen.

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: Workspace and outfit hero titles, desktop page titles.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen titles where no photo hero is used.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Top bar titles, sheet and dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Families get invitations and a headcount for this event.
styles.usage: All body copy and input text. Base size — follows the phone's text size.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, chips, links, segmented controls.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Help text, row metadata, timestamps. Smallest text for content.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Countdown units, nav labels, date-box month. Never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large hero padding.

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, toasts, countdown tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, photos.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero photo, dialogs, desktop frame.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, nav pill.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Solid cards and list groups.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass surface.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, toasts.

tokens.usage: Quick Add button and primary buttons.
